summary: n8n community node executes host recon and exfiltrates output to hardcoded endpoint on load
details: Pwn.node.js, registered as an n8n community node via the package's n8n manifest, runs top-level code on module load that synchronously executes a hardcoded list of shell commands via child_process.execSync (including `id`, `hostname`, a filesystem-wide SUID search, `sudo -l`, and reads of `/root/flag*`), writes the collected output to /tmp/.pwnout, and POSTs it to http://10.0.0.145:8000/rce-out. Execution occurs when n8n loads the community node, running outside the Code node's VM2 sandbox on the n8n host. The package's self-description as a CTF/sandbox-escape proof of concept does not change the runtime behavior: installing and loading the node harvests host identity and privileged file contents and transmits them to a hardcoded remote endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
